sources.observation: The stacked wall courses carry dense shallow niches and small silhouettes. The square mass steps inward below the central peak.
The three upper platforms carry flared stone bells with open apertures, moulded plinths and pointed finials.

limitations: The mapped perimeter establishes the overall scale and alignment. Individual reliefs, niches, step dimensions and small statues are simplified original geometry.
The Terrarium surface gives an approximate perimeter datum. The surrounding precinct, trees and the other temples remain distinct.
